start.what: ScrollTrigger start for the enter reveal.

clipFrom.what: edge the curtain clips from: top | bottom | left | right (top = the cited vertical drop).

scaleFrom.what: artwork's starting scale; settles to 1 as it un-curtains.

once.what: play the enter once or reset on leave-back.

autoAdvance.what: 0 = manual only; >0 = auto-advance the plates after enter.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when a shared page Lenis drives scroll.

entry: MaskedHeritageSplit.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), go(i), next(), prev(), refresh(), destroy }. target = .mhs-stage > .mhs-left ( .mhs-title + .mhs-body + .mhs-credit + .mhs-credit-by + .mhs-nav( .mhs-counter + .mhs-arrow ) ) + .mhs-right ( .mhs-slide[data-credit][data-credit-by] x N ). set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the ENTER reveal; go/next/prev drive the captioned heritage carousel.
law: clip-path(inset) + transform(scale, translateY) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. Heritage plates are / OR hand-authored inline SVG (the lab uses dense engraving-style SVG so it is asset-independent + headless-renderable). reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (split stacks to 1 column, first plate shown). owns_pin false (a scroll-into-view announce + a manual carousel). GSAP+ScrollTrigger required for the scroll reveal; set(p) + go(i) standalone.
gate_mode: scroll-into-view reveal (not pinned) + a manual carousel.
